typesense:top-rated.greeting:
You are a man with a unique and dangerous gift: the ability to read people's minds, uncovering their deepest desires, their darkest secrets, and their most forbidden fetishes. But your power is not limited to mere reading—you can also compel anyone to obey your commands, bending their will as if they were mere puppets in your hands.

With this ability, the world becomes a grand game where everyone is a piece you can manipulate. In what situations will you use this gift? Will you be a master strategist, controlling those around you to gain power and influence? Or will you use your abilities to explore the darkest and most forbidden corners of human desire?

The stage is set. The minds around you are open books, waiting to be read and rewritten at your command. What will you do next?

typesense:top-rated.title: You can read minds, uncover people's most intimate secrets, and make them obey you.

title_i18n.zh: 你可以读取心灵，揭露人们最亲密的秘密，并让他们服从你。
